name: v143_realized_vol_smooth_market
hypothesis: KPbzORql passed Sharpe but missed Fitness. Longer vol windows, MARKET neutralization, and a cap/liquidity regime may reduce churn while preserving realized-vol term compression.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.35, 0.320 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(historical_volatility_20 - historical_volatility_180), 126), industry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(parkinson_volatility_20 - parkinson_volatility_180), 126), industry) + 0.180 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative, 90)) + 0.140 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(earnings_certainty_rank_derivative, 90)) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Fitness repair for KPbzORql; broader and smoother, no implied-vol mean leg to test realized-vol independence.

name: v143_realized_meaniv_compact
hypothesis: A small mean-IV compression leg may lift Fitness for realized-vol compression while still being different enough from e7OG3bmz because realized volatility remains the parent.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) > 0.45, 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(historical_volatility_20 - historical_volatility_180), 90), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(parkinson_volatility_20 - parkinson_volatility_180), 90), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(implied_volatility_mean_360 - implied_volatility_mean_30), 90), industry) + 0.160 * rank(-1 * multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * earnings_certainty_rank_derivative) + 0.080 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: If this passes metrics, correlation gate must decide whether the mean-IV leg makes it too close to e7OG3bmz.

name: v143_smoothed_model_realized_confirm
hypothesis: P0pzZzkW suggested model-led structure has returns but not Sharpe. Smoothing the model derivatives and confirming with realized-vol compression may improve stability.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) > 0.40, 0.300 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative, 90)) + 0.240 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(earnings_certainty_rank_derivative, 90)) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(historical_volatility_30 - historical_volatility_180), 126), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(parkinson_volatility_30 - parkinson_volatility_180), 126), industry) + 0.120 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Model-led repair without skew; tests whether skew was noisy in P0pzZzkW.

name: v143_model_skew_cap_smooth
hypothesis: A cap-gated and smoothed version of model-led skew may keep P0pzZzkW's returns while reducing low-quality event noise.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.40, 0.310 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative, 90)) + 0.240 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(earnings_certainty_rank_derivative, 90)) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(implied_volatility_mean_skew_20 - implied_volatility_mean_skew_120), 126), industry) + 0.150 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 20)) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Compact Sharpe repair for P0pzZzkW; no pure skew/call-put expansion.
